description: This file contains unit tests for PDFsharp library, specifically testing PDF reading, writing, and modifications using the xUnit testing framework. It includes tests for empty and invalid PDF files, ensuring document saving and loading integrity, handling of various number formats, custom property handling, page orientation, size modifications, and complex page cloning scenarios.

classes.name: ReaderTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for the PDFsharp library, testing PDF document reading, writing, modification, and property handling.

methods.name: ReaderTests
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the PDFsharp test environment.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Resets the PDFsharp environment after each test.

methods.name: Read_empty_file
methods.description: Test case: Reads an empty byte array as a PDF, expects InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: Read_invalid_file
methods.description: Test case: Reads a random byte array as a PDF, expects InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: Write_and_read_test
methods.description: Creates a PDF, saves and reloads it, verifying data integrity and consistency.

methods.name: Read_reals_and_integers_test
methods.description: Tests parsing and handling various numerical formats, including integers, longs, and real numbers within PDF content.

methods.name: Custom_properties_test
methods.description: Tests setting, saving, loading, and verifying custom document info properties with non-ASCII and special characters.

methods.name: Read_and_modify_PDF_file_PageOrientation_test
methods.description: Creates multiple pages with different orientations and rotations; modifies and verifies page orientation and frames.

methods.name: Read_and_modify_PDF_file_CustomPageSize_PageOrientation_test
methods.description: Creates pages with custom sizes, modifies them, and imports pages, verifying dimensions and page content adjustments.
